content:
opsbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPENED: high paging + GPU memory pressure on prod-runtime-1. Auto-alert threshold tripped (page-faults > 500/min, GPU mem free < 6%). Investigate and mitigate. Pager: @mike_oncall. Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/streams/3532102468

mike_oncall: on it. picking this up now. paging spike started ~3532102400 according to metrics. will collect quick snapshots.

mike_oncall: initial customer impact — 2 requests/min failing with 504 for alpha-inc, latency spike for others. low overall error rate but sustained tail. cc @sarah_support

sarah_support: confirmed alpha-inc reported timeouts from their inference endpoint ~16:30 PDT. Trying to correlate with their request id samples. They said 5 of 200 requests timed out. Not yet a customer outage, but they flagged it.
\

opsbot: on-call handoff scheduled in 12m. next escalation path: infra -> runtime -> ml.
\

dana_prod: sharing quick metrics dump (GPU mem + kernel allocs). pastebin: https://logs.redwood.internal/snippets/3532102468/gpu-metrics.txt

lee_infra: looking at the node: prod-runtime-1. Observed repeated GPU pagewalks and kernel retries. GPU utilization steady but free memory oscillating. Suspicious eviction churn around batch tails.

lee_infra: here's a small diagnostic from `nvml` snapshot:
```
GPU 0: total 48GB, used 43.7GB, free 4.3GB
KV cache occupancy: 87% (hot entries skew)
Page-faults/min: 620 -> 1200 spike
Active allocations: many small fragments ~4MB
```

pranav_ml: kv-cache hypothesis: high prefix sharing + large batch sizes are causing many small KV allocations and preventing coalescing, leading to fragmentation and eviction thrash. Also seeing large tail token sequences increasing KV usage.

mike_oncall: mitigation suggestions? we should do low-risk changes first.

lee_infra: propose immediate runtime change: reduce max_batch_size from 16 -> 8 for prod-runtime-1, and enable `kv_swap` (experimental) for this node to push cold KV pages to host memory. This is reversible and low-risk. Command to apply (ops):
```
POST /admin/runtime/prod-runtime-1/config
{ "max_batch_size":8, "kv_swap_enabled": true }
```

mike_oncall: deploying that now. will watch error rate and paging.

opsbot: deploy job started by @mike_oncall (job id 3532102475). ETA ~ 45s.

mike_oncall: done. config applied. monitoring.

lee_infra: after change: page-faults dropped to ~280/min, GPU free rose to 10GB, but tail latency for small requests increased slightly (p95+).

pranav_ml: good sign. please also capture a KV histogram and prefix distribution so we can validate hypothesis. Endpoint: `GET /debug/prod-runtime-1/kvstats`

mike_oncall: kvstats dump uploaded: https://logs.redwood.internal/snippets/3532102468/kvstats.json

pranav_ml: looking — heavy skew toward a small set of prefixes (top 0.5% prefixes account for 42% of KV occupancy). That explains fragmentation: hot entries pinned and many small cold entries causing slab churn.

sarah_support: customer update: alpha-inc saw errors cease ~3m after config change. They asked if this will be permanent. I'll tell them we're investigating root cause and will follow up.

lee_infra: action items in-thread:
- collect full GPU memory timeline (metric granularity 10s) for last 2 hours (owner: dana_prod)
- KV histogram + prefix distribution (owner: pranav_ml) — grabbed
- Audit recent deploys + model config changes (owner: mike_oncall)
- Prepare short customer note (owner: sarah_support)

dana_prod: exporting 10s timeline to logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/exports/3532102468/gpu-timeline.csv (CSV, 2h).

mike_oncall: no recent deploys to runtime in the last 24h. only change was model rollout yesterday but pinned. will dig into request mix.

pranav_ml: hypothesis summary for RCA: fragmentation driven by skewed prefix distribution + large batch sizes causing many small KV allocations and eviction churn. Mitigations: batch-size cap, kv_swap (host-backed cold storage), and aggressive KV compaction in the runtime.

lee_infra: for immediate postmortem let's collect kernel logs and a sample `malloc` backlog. I'm grabbing them and will add to the incident timeline. link forthcoming.

opsbot: reminder: create incident RCA doc under /incidents/rca/3532102468 when you have timeline.

mike_oncall: recording timeline and initial hypotheses in this thread. plan: 1) finalize metrics + logs, 2) run controlled test (batch-size 12->8) on staging to validate threshold, 3) propose permanent runtime change or model-side batching limit.

pranav_ml: I'll run a staging test this afternoon. will post results here.

sarah_support: finished customer note draft, sending to legal for review, will publish after approval.

lee_infra: next steps agreed. if paging reappears, escalate to capacity ops for node remediation. For now, keeping prod-runtime-1 at max_batch_size=8 and kv_swap enabled.

mike_oncall: closing active pager for now — we will monitor for 1h and then hand off to postmortem queue. thanks all. :thumbsup:

opsbot: INCIDENT TRANSITION: to RCA queue. incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. timeline end ts: 3532103550

pranav_ml: assign RCA owner? I'm happy to own the hypothesis validation and report.

mike_oncall: assigning RCA to @pranav_ml. please include recommended changes, risk, and rollback plan.

sarah_support: I'll follow up with alpha-inc with summary and ETA for full RCA.

lee_infra: adding a note: we should also consider improved slab coalescing in next runtime release to reduce fragmentation for skewed workloads.

mike_oncall: noted. end of thread.
